svg.text: MERIDIAN MOONLIGHT — DEFENCE LAYERS
What stops someone tying into the compute
The primary tier is the one we can prove the least about. A PC cannot attest itself the way a phone can, so trust has to be
earned through behaviour rather than asserted by hardware.
LAYER 0 — THE FOUNDATION
Inference only. No arbitrary code, ever.
A job is a prompt plus a task-type ID from a list compiled into the client. Science runs as audited
kernels, never as submitted code — on PCs exactly as on phones. There is no privileged tier.
Eliminates mining, cracking, malware, and proxy abuse
outright — not by policy, but because there is no
execution path for them to use.
THE TRUST LADDER — WHAT A MACHINE IS ALLOWED TO DO ALONE
TIER
CAN IT PROVE WHAT IT IS?
WHAT IT MAY DO
Phone, attested
Yes — Play Integrity / DeviceCheck
Any work, including answering alone
PC with TPM 2.0 or Secure Enclave
Partly — hardware root of trust
Answers alone once reputation is earned
PC, unattested — the largest tier
No. Anyone can fake a thousand.
Corroborated work only, permanently
Anything behaving anomalously
Fails timing or capability checks
Served nothing; its results discarded
Unattested machines are never excluded — that would discard most of the network, and the machines least likely to have a TPM belong to
exactly the people this project exists for. They are simply never trusted alone.
HOW TRUST IS ACTUALLY EARNED AND CHECKED
IS THE WORK REAL
Canaries and re-checks
Known-answer jobs hidden in real work,
plus silent re-runs against a trusted
machine. New PCs get canaries far more
often than established ones.
CAN A FAKE FLEET WIN
Sybil buys identity, not capacity
A thousand VMs on one machine still
have one machine's compute. Copies of a
job never share a subnet, provider, or
region — a VM farm fails all three.
NO PRIZE TO WIN
Nothing to cash out
Credits cannot be sold or transferred, so
a fake fleet's earnings are stranded. And
because credits track hours rather than
speed, faking fast hardware gains nothing.
Model weights are hash-verified at load — tampered weights never run
Reputation starts at zero and is earned over weeks. It cannot be bought
Not solved: whoever runs a machine can read what it processes, and a patient attacker with genuinely distributed hardware can still poison some results.
